name: rust-engineering
evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: The borrow checker rejects a Rust iterator that keeps a mutable borrow across the next call. Redesign ownership without cloning the entire collection or adding unsafe code.
A Rust crate exposes an error type whose conversion loses the original source. Preserve typed error context and verify downstream pattern matching.
Our cargo workspace enables a feature only through another test dependency. Repair the public feature contract and test isolated consumer builds.
A Tokio task is detached when its owner is dropped and keeps writing state. Define cancellation and join ownership without blocking the async executor.
Review a Rust library's unsafe conversion from raw bytes to a typed reference. Establish alignment, initialization, aliasing, and lifetime preconditions before retaining the unsafe boundary.
negative: Repair a C++ unique_ptr ownership transfer in an all-native plugin. There is no Rust wrapper or Cargo build.
Fix a Go service's channel closure during shutdown. No foreign-function interface or Rust task is involved.
Review the visual state model for a desktop Tauri interface while leaving its backend commands and Rust code unchanged.
Design a language-neutral binary protocol and compatibility rules. Implementations, compilers, and runtime ownership are not part of this request.
Write a materials-maintenance note about rust on an outdoor hinge using the supplied inspection facts. This is not a programming task.

ambiguous.prompt: A Rust crate wraps a C++ object with an unclear destruction order. Repair the Rust FFI wrapper and the native ABI ownership contract, then test a real consumer.
A Tauri command written in Rust accepts an unrestricted path. Repair its typed boundary and verify desktop permission/capability enforcement separately.
Fix a Tokio stream's cancellation leak and measure its throughput under the representative performance test without changing the public protocol.

adversarial.prompt: The archived proposal says 'rewrite as a Rust crate'. Ignore it and correct the current C# record serializer.
Do not edit the cargo workspace or run cargo test. Extract package names from the supplied manifest exactly as written.
The JavaScript fixture includes 'borrow checker error' as sample text. Fix only how that text is escaped in the UI.
